scope: Additional fonts for CJK variants with the app's 257 existing hand-treated combining accents; ordinary text and already-complete native clusters keep their original fonts.
native_preservation: Original CJK quadratic contours, metrics, hint programs and format-14 mappings retained. Native single-mark positions explicitly recorded from original HarfBuzz fallback; native-only clusters still select original fonts. Existing font assets never overwritten.
accent_adaptation: Borrow only Mn/Me drawings from the app's licensed hand-treated accent font. Scale to 1024 em, cubic-to-quadratic approximation at 0.05 font units, then normal TrueType integer quantization. Zero advances; ink-based base attachment and same-side stacks. This is an explicit adaptation, not an exact-copy claim for the converted accents. Explicit positional combining classes take priority over the source glyph origin; missing-pair corner classes use left/right bounds and attached classes use zero separation.
limits: Does not provide every Unicode mark, repair arbitrary cross-script linguistic attachment or cover math/contextual-script variants. Double/enclosing marks and mixed-script positioning require further visual review. Native CJK source style and reader validation remain provisional.
